title: chiseledmilk's simple redo
description: makes MOST blocks, items, and entities simpler.
body:
a resource pack that makes nearly everything simpler
### what changes?

not too much so far. just a few blocks and items, but it's pretty early in development.

### will there be more versions frequently? if so, how frequently?

it depends honestly. if i have the time and feel like it, i'll do some resources. you may see new versions every once in a while, but don't be anticipating it.

### why only 1.20.1?

the reason for it being only one version right now is because thats simply the version i choose to work with the most. in my opinion, its the most recent version that actually supports most mods and resource packs, so i decided i would start there. i will most likely make support for some other versions too, but don't expect EVERY version to get support.
